title: Benchmark item
description: One released benchmark item, written by 04_build_benchmark to gcs://<bucket>/benchmark/v0.N/. Released versions are immutable. Scope is internal control over financial reporting (ICFR) generally; SOX 404 is one regime among several, recorded per item rather than assumed.

item_id.description: Task letter plus zero-padded ordinal, e.g. C-0142.

input.description: What the model sees. Shape varies by task.

label.description: Ground truth. Keys populated depend on task.

coso_component.description: Task A primary label, and Task D secondary. Jurisdiction-neutral, which is why Task A is anchored here rather than on severity.

severity.description: Task A SECONDARY label, present only on gradient-bearing items. SEC rules compel disclosure of material weaknesses only, so items sourced from 10-K/20-F/40-F filings are almost entirely material_weakness and carry gradient_bearing:false. Score severity on the gradient-bearing subset only; scoring it corpus-wide measures the sampling frame, not the model.

gradient_bearing.description: True when this item's source could have expressed a severity other than material_weakness — Single Audit findings and synthetic items. False for SEC periodic filings.

gap_type.description: Task B, required when designed_effectively is false

citation.description: Task D. COSO principle number or PCAOB standard reference. Never verbatim framework text.

label_source.description: Provenance of the ground truth. 'llm_draft' is NOT a valid released value — 04_build_benchmark hard-fails on it. Only the reviewer-triggered Apps Script path may write 'llm_draft_human_verified'.

clean_confidence.description: Task C clean items only. A clean label means nobody disclosed a weakness — absence of disclosure, not absence of deficiency — so its strength varies. 'attested': an auditor issued an ICFR opinion behind the assertion (accelerated and large accelerated non-EGC filers). 'management_only': management assertion with no 404(b) attestation. 'excluded_restated': a later Item 4.02 8-K or subsequent-period material weakness contradicts the clean label; these must not reach a release. The headline false-positive rate is reported on the 'attested' subset, where a false positive means what the word implies.

paraphrased.description: True for contamination-control twins of verbatim items.

paraphrase_of.description: item_id of the verbatim twin. Required when paraphrased is true.

minimal_pair_id.description: Synthetic items only. Two items sharing this id are identical except for one deliberate change — the same control with and without a segregation-of-duties gap, for instance. A model that answers both correctly is reasoning about the control; one that flips on surrounding language is not. Real filings cannot produce this.

pair_role.description: Which half of a minimal pair. Required when minimal_pair_id is set.

origin.description: Which source tier produced this item. 'sec_periodic' is 10-K/20-F/40-F; 'sec_comment_letter' is UPLOAD/CORRESP, where staff questioned a filer's own ICFR conclusion; 'single_audit' is a Federal Audit Clearinghouse finding; 'synthetic' is hand-authored or drafted-then-verified.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of the reporting entity's home jurisdiction, or 'XX' for synthetic items with no real filer.

regime.description: The regulatory regime the assertion was made under. A 40-F filer is a Canadian company complying with SOX, so jurisdiction CA and regime sox_404 — the two are independent and pooling them silently would be a methodological error. 'none' for synthetic.

auditor_attested.description: Whether an auditor issued an ICFR attestation. Drives clean_confidence, and is a materially different evidence standard from a management-only assertion.

fac_report_id.description: Federal Audit Clearinghouse report identifier, for single_audit items.

drafted_by.description: Synthetic items only. Full pinned model identifier of the model that drafted the scenario, or 'human'. Required so results can be split by drafting model — if items drafted by a vendor's model favour that vendor, that bias must be visible rather than buried.
